title: Q’eswachaka Inca Bridge Full-Day Tour
short_description: Discover Q’eswachaka, the last handwoven Inca bridge, on a full-day journey from Cusco filled with living culture, history and southern Andean scenery.
long_description: Discover Q’eswachaka, the last Inca bridge preserving the ancestral art of weaving plant fibers. Travel from Cusco to Canas Province through traditional high-Andean landscapes. See the approximately 28-meter-long bridge suspended above the Apurímac River and renewed by local communities using knowledge passed down for generations.

days.title: Day 1: Cusco – Q’eswachaka – Cusco
days.text: Depart early from Cusco for Canas Province, crossing Andean landscapes and traditional communities. Visit the Q’eswachaka Inca Bridge, an approximately 28-meter suspension bridge woven from plant fibers above the Apurímac River. Your guide explains its history, symbolism and communal renewal. Explore the surroundings and take photos before returning to Cusco.
